title: Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
abstract: arXiv:2611.26588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A passing UVM regression shows the design agrees with the reference model on what the scoreboard checks, not that it meets the specification. Bugs that pass every test yet violate the specification, termed scoreboard escapes, survive mature testbenches. We present Verify the Verifier, to our knowledge the first framework whose LLM-based Anomaly Cross-Checker examines a passing regression's traces against the specification. Of 564 bugs inserted into four OpenTitan IPs, 68 are candidate scoreboard escapes: non-equivalent, exercised by the tests, yet passing. The framework confirmed 41 as scoreboard escapes with assertions failing on the buggy design and proven on the original.

translated_title: 验证验证器：基于规范的LLM交叉检查，捕获逃过UVM记分板的缺陷
translated_abstract: 通过的UVM回归测试仅表明设计与参考模型在记分板所检查的内容上一致，并不能表明其符合规范。那些通过所有测试却违反规范的缺陷，被称为“记分板逃逸”，即使面对成熟的测试平台也能存活。我们提出“Verify the Verifier”（验证验证器），据我们所知，这是首个利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的异常交叉检查器，将已通过回归测试的追踪记录与规范进行比对的框架。在注入到四个OpenTitan IP的564个缺陷中，有68个是候选的记分板逃逸缺陷：它们与原始设计不等价、被测试所覆盖，却能通过测试。该框架确认其中41个为记分板逃逸缺陷——相关断言在缺陷设计上失败，并在原始设计上得到验证通过。
tldr: 提出首个基于规范、利用LLM交叉检查已通过回归测试追踪记录的框架"Verify the Verifier"，从564个注入缺陷中确认了41个逃过UVM记分板检查的缺陷。
en_tdlr: We present Verify the Verifier, the first framework whose LLM-based Anomaly Cross-Checker examines passing regression traces against the specification, confirming 41 out of 564 injected bugs as scoreboard escapes that evade UVM scoreboards.
